note: Track 2 candidate decks (manamind #96, built 2026-11-09): candidate second pairs for the expert-vs-expert seat-balance read. Brews assembled from the scripted card pool (354 scripts on main), not meta lists: mono-white-aggro (lifegain-aggro with Pridemate payoffs), mono-blue-tempo (fliers + countermagic + bounce), mono-black-aggro (low-curve drain + removal), mono-green-ramp (elves into fatties), mono-blue-control (counters + draw + tap-lock auras). mono-red-aggro is copied verbatim from 2614-decks.json so the red-vs-black candidate reuses the existing yardstick deck. Card records are trimmed Scryfall objects (engine fields only, standard-legal). X-cost spells, vehicles, and sagas avoided pending engine behavior; Hornet Queen and Avenger of Zendikar dropped (not standard-legal in the pool fetch).
